name: somnascan
description: SomnaScan: in-browser sleep disorder screening dashboard (React) with a small FastAPI server.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend ci && python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.start: npm run build && python -m uvicorn server:app --app-dir backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
